notes: Hybrid v1.4 (2026-11-26): the v1.4 group-token models (orchestration docs/model_specs/v14_group_tokens.txt). Model 1 = m1_v4 (rt_continuation_chordal.onnx = ovn_m1v4_d3 best step 500 on data v3, 2026-11-27; vocab 12096) while the piano is silent; model 2 = m2_v4 (rt_simultaneous_chordal.onnx = ovn_m2v4_d3 best step 500 on data v3; vocab 12239) while it plays; v1.2's switching rules. A group of orchestra notes is [onset][dur][BASS][SHAPE x N][vel]; the WAIT block is [SDUR][BASS][SHAPE x N][SVEL] (or [SDUR][PITCH][SVEL] when k = 1). Groups go to the OT / playback as one chord token, decoded there with voicing_bank_v4.json (in virtual_orch_models). Model 2 draws nothing for the first startDelayMs. Durations of both models at durationTemperature 1.0 / durationMinP 0 (not otherTemperature 0.5 / minP 0.25: those collapse the durations to 10 cs); model 2's WAIT share capped at waitCeiling 0.8 at the onset step (m2v4_d3 WAITs ~90% on dense piano; orchestration decisions_112726.txt).
